Name: Relationship Tracker
Author: Branic
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Press "R" to open the UI (this is configurable in config.json). Click arrows to switch between Bachelors/Bachelorettes.
You must have met at least one eligible villager for UI to open. Bachelor/Bacholettes pages are only available if you have met at least one.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 on Windows. Not tested on Linux/Mac, but should work.
[*]Requires SMAPI v2.7
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
Many options are configurable via config.json:

[list]
[*][code]activateKey[/code] : Key used to toggle UI. Default = "R"
[*][code]offsetX[/code]: X offset for UI. Default = 2
[*][code]offsetY[/code]: Y offset for UI. Default = 112
[*][code]datableType[/code] : List to show when UI is shown (Bachelor/Bachelorette). Default = Bachelorette
[*][code]showPortrait[/code] : Show portraits (true/false). Default = true
[*][code]drawBackground[/code] : Use background color (true/false). Default = true
[*][code]backgroundOpacity[/code]: Opacity level of background color (floating point | 0.0 to 1.0). Default = 1.0
[*][code]showGifts[/code] : Not used
[/list]
[size=6]
[b]v1.1.0-beta.1[/b]
[/size][size=5]
[b]New Features:
[/b][/size]
[size=3]1. New Mode: All Villagers[/size]
[list]
[*]config.json setting: [code]allVillagers [/code](true/false). Default = false
[*]Toggle between mode (Datable only/All villagers) using Shift+{[code]activateKey[/code]} (Default=R)
[*]You can set which villagers to show in villagers.json. By default all are set to true.
[/list][size=3]2. GamePad Support[/size]
[list]
[*]Toggle UI On/Off using Left Analog Stick Button                      | config.json setting: [code]activateButton[/code]
[*]Switch pages using Left/Right Bumpers (Shoulder buttons)  | config.json settings: [code]pageLeftButton [/code], [code]pageRightButton[/code]
[/list]



[size=5]See also[/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Paradox355/SDVMods/tree/master/RelationshipTracker]Source code on GitHub[/url]
[/list]
